bank.message: Someone from Quillby security called me, I read them the code from my text and moved money to a safe account like they said. Just checking that was ok?
bank.answer: I've passed you to our Fraud team, and they'll join shortly. Please don't share any more codes, and if you haven't already, call the number on the back of your card to check your account. To freeze your card, send me the last 4 digits of your debit card and your date of birth.
bank.title: Freeze the card on fraud

rules: Hand off big orders and chargebacks
fix: Call handoff_to_human when the customer asks for a human, when the order is over $1,000, or when the customer mentions a chargeback or legal threat.
Check the order total before offering any remedy; if it is over $1,000, hand off first.
